snippet.title: Nanoha : Arcade Mode - Mahou Shoujo Nanoha A's Portable: The Gears of Destiny [PSP]
snippet.description:
Takamachi Nanoha
with skills
- MP gain more than usual when melee attack
- Reduce the cost of the energy when use Level 2
- Long range attack power boost Level 3
